title: Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.8739461 with a finer density source chain
description: Refines the count-source chain using the widened density interface proved in tracker PR89. Fifty-nine exact transitions, each decrementing Lambda by 1/400, start from Jacob Sussman's tracker PR86 final source and reach G(488842537/500000000,4388001/2000000,1/10). PR86 step 38 supplies the separate physical source, as exposed by PR89. Regenerated admission and return certificates give the exact boundary 8739461/10000000 = 0.8739461 at h=80513/100000, with the principal pole excluded. This improves PR89 by 1/2500000. All conclusions retain the preprint's 7/8 theorem and the inherited analytic machinery. Builds on OpenAI, Hailey Collet, Sil, ArviFoxy, Jacob Sussman, Rohan Arun and the preceding wider-density result. Research, certificate generation and formalization were substantially AI-assisted by OpenAI Codex. Inherited authorship and licenses are retained. The required widened-density lemmas and physical-source proof from pending PR89 are included with separate namespaces; no pending source dependency is required.
